description:
Configure WooCommerce email notifications to route specific alerts to different departments. 

Goal: Update the recipients for the following email notifications, removing the default admin address:
1. 'New order' -> fulfillment@example.com
2. 'Cancelled order' -> accounting@example.com
3. 'Failed order' -> sysadmin@example.com

Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Emails to make these changes.
